facts.fact: The Nation names Dr Vincent Olatunji as National Commissioner/CEO of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, speaking at NITDA's stakeholders' review workshop on 18 September 2025.

facts.fact: The Nation reports NITDA's Director General said the draft Technical Standard for Nigeria Data Exchange (NGDX) was under stakeholder review on 18 September 2025, with implementation possibly beginning in the first quarter of 2026.
